closing.text: Book through WhataHotel's preferred rate and you'll get free daily breakfast for two, priority for an upgrade at check-in when one is available, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a $100 hotel credit, with a higher credit for suites. It can also be combined with the hotel's listed exclusive perks, subject to the terms of each offer.
